text: Integer views shall use the selected byte order and requested N-bit encoding. Typed stores shall clear unused high representation bits and preserve neighboring independently accessible values; loads shall ignore high bits outside N. Allocation padding shall not be interpreted.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
